title: Integrating bioinformatics and machine learning to identify AhR-related gene signatures for prognosis and tumor microenvironment modulation in melanoma.
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习构建黑色素瘤预后模型，聚焦AhR相关基因表达与免疫微环境，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor (AhR) pathway significantly influences immune cell regulation, impacting the effectiveness of immunotherapy and patient outcomes in melanoma. However, the specific downstream targets and mechanisms by which AhR influences melanoma remain insufficiently understood. METHODS: Melanoma samples from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) and normal skin tissues from the Genotype-Tissue Expression (GTEx) database were analyzed to identify differentially expressed genes, which were intersected with a curated list of AhR-related pathway genes. Prognostic models were subsequently developed, and feature genes were identified. Advanced methodologies, including Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) and immune cell infiltration analysis, were employed to explore the biological significance of these genes. The stability of the machine learning models and the relationship between gene expression and immune infiltrating cells were validated using three independent melanoma datasets. A mouse melanoma model was used to validate the dynamic changes of the feature genes during tumor progression. The relationship between the selected genes and drug sensitivity, as well as non-coding RNA interactions, was thoroughly investigated. RESULTS: Our analysis identified a robust prognostic model, with four AhR-related genes (MAP2K1, PRKACB, KLF5, and PIK3R2) emerging as key contributors to melanoma progression. GSEA revealed that these genes are involved in primary immunodeficiency. Immune cell infiltration analysis demonstrated enrichment of CD4(+) naive and memory T cells, macrophages (M0 and M2), and CD8(+) T cells in melanoma, all of which were associated with the expression of the four feature genes. Importantly, the diagnostic power of the prognostic model and the relevance of the feature genes were validated in three additional independent melanoma datasets. In the mouse melanoma model, Map2k1 and Prkacb mRNA levels exhibited a progressive increase with tumor progression, supporting their role in melanoma advancement. CONCLUSIONS: This study presents a comprehensive analysis of AhR-related genes in melanoma, highlighting MAP2K1, PRKACB, KLF5, and PIK3R2 as key prognostic markers and potential therapeutic targets. The integration of bioinformatics and machine learning provides a robust framework for enhancing prognostic evaluation in melanoma patients and offers new avenues for the development of treatments, particularly for those resistant to current immunotherapies.
abstract_zh: 背景：芳香烃受体（Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor, AhR）通路显著影响免疫细胞调控，进而影响黑色素瘤免疫治疗的效果及患者预后。然而，AhR在黑色素瘤中发挥作用的具体下游靶点及机制仍了解不足。方法：分析来自癌症基因组图谱（The Cancer Genome Atlas, TCGA）的黑色素瘤样本和基因型-组织表达（Genotype-Tissue Expression, GTEx）数据库的正常皮肤组织，以识别差异表达基因，并将其与AhR相关通路基因的精选列表进行交集。随后构建预后模型并鉴定特征基因。采用基因集富集分析（Gene Set Enrichment Analysis, GSEA）和免疫细胞浸润分析等先进方法，探索这些基因的生物学意义。利用三个独立的黑色素瘤数据集验证机器学习模型的稳定性及基因表达与免疫浸润细胞之间的关系。使用小鼠黑色素瘤模型验证特征基因在肿瘤进展过程中的动态变化。深入研究了所选基因与药物敏感性及非编码RNA相互作用的关系。结果：我们的分析确定了一个稳健的预后模型，其中四个AhR相关基因（MAP2K1、PRKACB、KLF5和PIK3R2）成为黑色素瘤进展的关键贡献者。GSEA揭示这些基因参与原发性免疫缺陷。免疫细胞浸润分析显示，黑色素瘤中CD4(+)初始和记忆T细胞、巨噬细胞（M0和M2）及CD8(+) T细胞富集，且均与四个特征基因的表达相关。重要的是，预后模型的诊断能力及特征基因的相关性在三个额外的独立黑色素瘤数据集中得到验证。在小鼠黑色素瘤模型中，Map2k1和Prkacb mRNA水平随肿瘤进展逐渐升高，支持其在黑色素瘤进展中的作用。结论：本研究对黑色素瘤中AhR相关基因进行了全面分析，强调MAP2K1、PRKACB、KLF5和PIK3R2作为关键预后标志物和潜在治疗靶点。生物信息学与机器学习的整合为改善黑色素瘤患者的预后评估提供了稳健框架，并为开发治疗方法（尤其是针对当前免疫治疗耐药的患者）开辟了新途径。
